**94 files, 1082 lines. Only the JS variable names can move.**

| Zone | Files | Rename? |
|---|---|---|
| `services` | 75 | Yes, JS names only |
| `migrations` | 12 | No, all applied in prod |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 4 | No, `vendor:refresh` overwrites |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` + `lib/serialize.js` | 2 | No, frozen public contract |

The DB column stays `account_id`. So SQL text inside repos keeps it too, like `WHERE account_id = ?`.

Next: tell them the rename is local variables only, not a blind find and replace.
